checks.notes: External absolute paths and template placeholders are not treated as repository-path claims; explicitly historical sections are excluded.
checks.rule: Every repository path cited by a current-authority scope must resolve in the audited snapshot.
checks.title: Current-authority cited paths resolve

checks.notes: SHA-256 evidence hashes and explicitly historical tail sections are not interpreted as Git commit claims.
checks.rule: Every Git commit SHA cited by current-authority scope must resolve as a commit in the repository.
checks.title: Current-authority cited commits exist

checks.rule: Current-authority test-count claims must equal the identity-bound measured suite counts for this exact target, with zero failures, cancellations, skips or TODO tests.
checks.title: Current-authority test counts match measured counts

checks.rule: The audit program, current handoff, runner constant and requested baseline must declare the exact same 40-character product anchor.
checks.title: Controlling product baseline identity

checks.notes: Starting SHAs, superseded decision-register sections, prior APK evidence and explicitly historical sections are excluded from present-state comparison.
checks.rule: Typed present-state claims among current-authority scopes must not assign different values to the same fact.
checks.title: Current-authority contradictions
